fields.value: Supplementary materials PhD project Singing as a figure of speech and related publications

dsDescriptionValue.value:
Stimuli for several experiments reported on in the dissertation Singing as a figure of speech et cetera and related publications, and datasets related to other studies published in or related to the beforementioned dissertation.
1. Short MP3 files used in the experiments reported on in chapters 4.1. (MP3s titled C##), 4.1.2 (MP3s titled B##) and 4.2 (MP#s titled A##), and a PDF with texts and the scores for these stimuli.
2. An SPSS data file (.sav) with authors, titles, and analysis of the songs in four volumes of Dutch song texts see dissertation chapter 5
3. SPSS files related to the psalm research reported on in (Schotanus, Koops and Reed Edworthy, 2018).
4. Poster presented May 7th, 2016, at the KVNM spring meeting, Leiden. [Poster available at Academia Edu and ResearchGate].
